verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions linking errors to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, nor any two-way status sync. The GitHub integration shown is for repo connection and source maps, error resolution is a manual status change, and the Slack and PagerDuty integrations are alerting features, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it
